dataset.name: OCTMNIST (MedMNIST v2)
dataset.source: Kermany et al., Cell 2018; Yang et al., Scientific Data 2023

classes.name: Choroidal Neovascularization
classes.description: Abnormal blood vessels growing beneath the retina (wet AMD). Needs urgent referral.

classes.name: Diabetic Macular Edema
classes.description: Fluid accumulation in the macula caused by diabetic retinopathy.

classes.name: Drusen
classes.description: Yellow deposits under the retina; an early sign of age-related macular degeneration.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: Healthy retina with preserved foveal contour and no fluid or deposits.

preprocessing: Decode image, apply EXIF orientation, drop alpha channel
Centre-crop to a square on the short edge
Extract features and z-score standardise with training-set mean and std

baselines.name: Single-layer perceptron (Rosenblatt)
baselines.description: Linear decision boundaries, step activation, perceptron learning rule (scikit-learn).

baselines.name: Softmax regression (0 hidden layers, ours)
baselines.description: Our NumPy network with no hidden layer: a linear classifier trained by gradient descent.

baselines.name: Baseline MLP (scikit-learn, 1x100 ReLU, Adam)
baselines.description: Off-the-shelf multilayer perceptron with default settings, used as the baseline accuracy.

calibration.method: per-class additive log-bias (logit adjustment), coordinate search on a class-balanced subsample of validation (matches the balanced test protocol)

previous_version.step: Previous version (128 ReLU, no dropout, single model)

significance_vs_previous.test: exact McNemar, paired on the same 1,000 test images
